style: Soft hand-drawn Korean webtoon illustration, warm pastel colors, clean thin lineart, gentle cozy lighting, cute expressive original characters with big readable facial expressions, simple uncluttered background so the subject reads instantly on a phone. Original characters only, do not imitate any existing franchise or real person. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, signs with writing, or logos anywhere in the image.

prompts.name: kk_06_omakase
prompts.prompt: Split comedic scene. In front, a smug young Korean man in a nice jacket sits at a fancy omakase sushi counter, happily taking a photo of an expensive nigiri with his phone, chef serving behind him. In the back corner, his friend peeks through the restaurant door, eyes full of tears and rage, clutching an empty open wallet with moths flying out. Exaggerated webtoon expressions.

prompts.name: kk_07_readignore
prompts.prompt: Split-screen comedy. Left half: a young woman lounging on a sofa, grinning while posting a selfie on her phone, ignoring a pile of unread message notifications shown only as red dots with no numbers. Right half: her friend sitting on the floor staring at her own phone with a furious twitching face, veins popping, holding the phone so hard it cracks. Exaggerated webtoon expressions.

prompts.name: kk_08_toilet
prompts.prompt: A young Korean office worker in a shirt and tie sits fully clothed on a closed toilet lid inside a clean company restroom stall, legs crossed like a CEO, sipping iced coffee and scrolling his phone with a smug satisfied grin, sunglasses pushed up on his head. A wall clock without numbers above the stall. Comedic, relaxed, cozy lighting.

prompts.name: kk_09_janya
prompts.prompt: 2am bedroom, dark blue night lighting. A young woman lies in bed, face lit by her phone screen, making an extremely disgusted yet smug expression, one eyebrow raised, lip curled, as if she just received a message from her ex. Her other hand hovers over the phone. A small ghost-like silhouette of an ex-boyfriend with puppy eyes floats faintly above the phone. Comedic webtoon style.

prompts.name: kk_10_bill
prompts.prompt: A Korean barbecue restaurant table after a big group dinner, empty plates and bottles everywhere. One young man sits alone holding a very long receipt that drapes to the floor, face pale and frozen in shock. All the other chairs are empty, and through the window his friends are sprinting away down the street laughing, one waving goodbye. Exaggerated comedic webtoon expressions.
